models.name: Classification (pairwise ranker)
models.description: Leave-one-race-out backtest of pairwise XGBRanker vs OpenF1 session_result. Features: qualifying grid, recent/circuit form, shrunk pace, team form, rain. Tuned shallow pairwise (depth 3).

models.name: Classification (pairwise ranker)
models.description: Leave-one-race-out backtest of pairwise XGBRanker vs OpenF1 session_result. Form/pace use only earlier races (v2 and older leaked later results); monotone in grid/form/pace.

models.name: Lap-time Random Forest
models.description: Benchmark regressor on the same features/split as XGBoost (not used in live inference).

models.name: Lap-time Random Forest
models.description: Benchmark regressor on the same features/split as XGBoost (not used in live inference).

models.name: Lap-time XGBoost
models.description: Previous lap-time XGBoost (depth 6, 350 trees, no early stopping).

models.name: Lap-time XGBoost
models.description: Primary lap-time model (circuit baseline + residual). Includes compound×age / circuit×compound, stint features, wet compounds, SC downweight. Tuned shallow trees + early stopping.

models.name: Lap-time XGBoost
models.description: Primary lap-time model (season-normalised circuit baseline + residual). Baselines come from the train split only; v3 and older put test laps in their own baseline, so their MAE is not comparable.

models.name: Race time (XGBoost)
models.description: Previous absolute-duration regressor (no circuit prior / within-race gaps).

models.name: Race time (XGBoost)
models.description: Within-race gaps + circuit duration median. Absolute MAE capped by SC/red flags (~7–10 min); within_race_mae_s is the driver-relative metric. Features: grid, form, pace, distance, pit loss.

models.name: Race time (XGBoost)
models.description: Leave-one-race-out MAE/RMSE vs OpenF1 session_result.duration for classified finishers. Prior = lap pace × laps × learned ratio; red-flag races (Monaco, Monza 2026) dominate the mean.
